## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      1 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 20, 2026 - Sep 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _jesse p_, Jul 20, 2026, 3/5: "wird keinen design award gewinnen. keine werbung, alles nutzbar ohne paywall. WYSIWYG! von daher toll und hebt sich enorm von konkurrenten ab, habe kein gleichwertiges produkt gefunden. da man pro habit nicht für mehrmals pro tag tracken kann, für mich nicht verwendbar."
            2. _Arnav Singh_, Sep 2, 2026, 5/5: "Amazing app. No complex settings and features like other apps, no paid subscription, no ads, no locked features etc. Just raw habit tracker, with basic useful features, offline, clean ui and fast and reliable. Amazing.🤌🏻. EDIT - Would love if there was a web version of this app, making it available to ios, windows and other platforms."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      1 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Sep 29, 2026 - Sep 29, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Aarjav Dua_, Sep 29, 2026, 5/5: "Could you please please please add an option to group habits under a folder and have them open like a drop down folder, that shows sub grouped items upon clicking the folder? pleasee. otherwise good app. Also there is a glitch while using the notes section of a habit. When the notes section is long, it gets hidden because of the onscreen keyboard while using it. please fix it. also can we get a daily score on top of the habits that we did today and also the consistency graph for the same?"
